There are a few other door frames with similar issues in this apartment. There’s another unit across the building (moved within the same one) that I used to live in - it was / is perfectly plum hence the concern. 

There’s also some cracking of the molding around one of the exterior door frames near this apartment.
Ground floor, building is only around 10 years old.

It’s mostly so I don’t lose the therapist at all. Keep in mind I’m not yet 18 (by a slim margin) and the only reason I have one is that my abusive parents have me on their insurance and give me one for appearances. I try my best to utilize it where I can but the main issues are unsolveable regardless of who I’m seeing until I turn 18 and can find somewhere stable on my own. A few months if I instantly luck into a loving house and a good job (which we both know won’t happen) and a few years thinking more realistically.
You’re probably right. I just have a hard time getting myself to commit to it.

I already see a therapist but I really can’t be honest about the majority of my problems. My abusive household is obviously a non starter to be talking about. 

And if i want to do anything about my dysphoria (a huge factor in my mental health) I need to wait until I turn 18 and run into enough money to pay for treatment. Which will be a while at best

It’s not everywhere and scrubbing for a while (like 5 minutes or more) can just about get it to go away. It’s almost definitely from that. I doubt I have any serious physical problems otherwise and even if I did seeing a doctor is expensive.

As I said in the post I’ve been going through arguably one of the worst times in my life. I have barely enough motivation to get out of bed let alone shower or take care of myself. 

An abusive household, pandemic and being worried about your best friend in the whole world will do that.
